metadata.title: Tesla Stock Rides a 10% Weekly Gain Into a High-Stakes Delivery Report<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Tesla Stock Rides a 10% Weekly Gain Into a High-Stakes Delivery Report
Tesla is set to report deliveries over a period that included a war, soaring oil prices, and the ongoing effects of U.S. electric-vehicle policy changes.
